### encoded-bash | kinds=read | flags=encoded | sections=HOST
echo ZWNobyAnPT09IEhPU1QgPT09Jwp1cHRpbWU= | base64 -d | bash

### encoded-su | kinds=read | flags=encoded | sections=HOST
su - root -c "echo ZWNobyAnPT09IEhPU1QgPT09Jwp1cHRpbWU= | base64 -d | bash"

### encoded-eval | kinds=read | flags=encoded | sections=HOST
eval "$(echo ZWNobyAnPT09IEhPU1QgPT09Jwp1cHRpbWU= | base64 -d)"

### encoded-bad | kinds=unknown | flags=encoded | complete=false
echo 'not base64 at all' | base64 -d | bash

### encoded-write | kinds=write | flags=encoded
echo cm0gLXJmIC90bXAvc3ludGhldGljLWRpcg== | base64 -d | bash

### encoded-redirect | kinds=read,write | flags=encoded,redirect-to-file | sections=HOST
echo ZWNobyAnPT09IEhPU1QgPT09Jwp1cHRpbWU= | base64 -d | bash > /tmp/synthetic-out
